2026-10-09 12:55:41.057988 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-09 12:55:41.057991 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-09 12:55:41.057994 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-09 12:55:41.057997 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-10-09 12:55:41.058000 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
